assessment: Inspect summaries, topic minutes, decisions, tasks, evidence entailment, protected facts, accepted/rejected edits and failed responses. Schema/evidence validation is a separate outcome, not proof of semantic correctness. Official abstract annotations are a concise reference, not an exhaustive list of every valid item. Record paraphrases, compound rows and additional supported items rather than treating them automatically as hallucinations.
